Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 14  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner erroneously concluded that the symbol of the New Orleans Saints is "Sir Saint" in step 14. The correct symbol is the fleur-de-lis, which is widely recognized as the official symbol of the New Orleans Saints. This mistake likely resulted from misinterpreting the available information or failing to effectively verify and confirm the traditionally accepted symbol with authoritative sources, even though earlier steps mentioned the association of the Saints with the fleur-de-lis.
